sourceEnglishObjective: Coordinate debris removal and deck cleanup
sourceEnglishSpeaking: Assign one worker to collect shingles and another to pull old nails.
candidateObjective: 廃材、古い釘、屋根下地の清掃を担当者に割り当てる。
candidateFocus: ～てから orders actions; ～前に marks the next task's prerequisite. 一人は～、もう一人は～ distributes work between two people.

archivedForms.exampleJa: ルーフィングを敷く前に屋根下地を掃きます。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: We sweep the deck before the underlayment.

archivedForms.exampleJa: シングル材を廃材用コンテナに投げ入れます。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: They throw the shingles into the debris dumpster.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 作業員が古い釘を全て抜きます。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: One worker pulls out all the old nails.

archivedForms.exampleJa: シングル材の破片を全て拾います。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: They pick up all the shingle pieces.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 一人はシャベルを使い、もう一人は手押し車を使います。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: One worker uses the shovel and another uses the wheelbarrow.

archivedSpeaking.opening: 一人はシングル材の破片を拾ってください。もう一人は古い釘を抜いてください。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Assign one worker to collect shingles and another to pull old nails.

curriculumAdaptationNote: Preserve after-tear-off debris, gloves, shingles into a debris dumpster, shovel and wheelbarrow split, pulling old nails, magnet over the yard, deck sweep before underlayment and reporting after magnetic nail pickup. Avoid turning the magnet pass into a guarantee that no nails remain. Confirm shingle material, wheelbarrow, debris, deck and underlayment senses before selecting Japanese learner text. Archived forms and speaking remain evidence only; this packet creates no learner, audio, score or progress identity.

cards.reviewNote: Escombros / debris includes rubble and removed material; archived 廃材 may imply only discard materials. Confirm inclusive Japanese site-cleanup term.
Carretilla / wheelbarrow is more specific than generic 手押し車 (handcart). Confirm equipment term for a wheelbarrow.

cards.sourceEnglish: Throw the shingles into the dumpster.
cards.archivedJapanese: シングル材を廃材用コンテナに投げ入れてください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Throw the shingles into the dumpster.
cards.reviewNote: Source English says shingles and Spanish tejas is material-dependent. Archived シングル材 may imply asphalt shingles; confirm the roof product before choosing the Japanese trade term.

cards.candidateJapanese: 古い釘を全て抜いてください。
cards.archivedJapanese: 古い釘を全て抜いてください。

cards.sourceSpanish: Barran la cubierta antes de la sub-capa.
cards.archivedJapanese: ルーフィングを敷く前に屋根下地を掃いてください。
cards.reviewNote: Cubierta / deck is the roof deck, while 屋根下地 can mean substrate; ルーフィング often means roofing felt rather than generic underlayment. Confirm both scope and installation sequence.

cards.sourceSpanish: Avísenme cuando terminen de recoger los clavos con el imán.
cards.sourceEnglish: Tell me when the magnetic nail sweep is finished.
cards.archivedJapanese: 磁石での釘拾いが終わったら知らせてください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Tell me when the magnetic nail sweep is finished.
cards.reviewNote: Magnetic nail sweep is a process, not proof of complete nail removal. Archived 磁石での釘拾い may omit the sweep action; confirm procedure wording.

cards.sourceSpanish: Recojan todos los pedazos de teja.
cards.sourceEnglish: Pick up all the shingle pieces.
cards.archivedJapanese: シングル材の破片を全て拾ってください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Pick up all the shingle pieces.
cards.reviewNote: Shingle pieces inherit card 10's material-specific Japanese term decision.

cards.candidateJapanese: 手袋を着けてください。
cards.archivedJapanese: 手袋を着けてください。

reader.sourceSpanish: Después del desmontaje hay escombros por todos lados.
reader.sourceEnglish: After the tear-off there is debris everywhere.
reader.archivedJapanese: 撤去の後、廃材があちこちにあります。
reader.archivedEnglish: After the tear-off there is debris everywhere.
reader.reviewNote: Debris after tear-off inherits card 4's rubble/material distinction; do not narrow to only discard material.

reader.candidateJapanese: 手袋を着けてください。
reader.archivedJapanese: 手袋を着けてください。

reader.sourceSpanish: Tiren las tejas al contenedor de escombros.
reader.sourceEnglish: Throw the shingles into the debris dumpster.
reader.archivedJapanese: シングル材を廃材用コンテナに投げ入れてください。
reader.archivedEnglish: Throw the shingles into the debris dumpster.
reader.reviewNote: Shingles in the debris dumpster inherit card 10's material-specific roofing term decision.

reader.sourceSpanish: Un obrero usa la pala y otro usa la carretilla.
reader.sourceEnglish: One worker uses the shovel and another uses the wheelbarrow.
reader.archivedJapanese: 一人はシャベルを使い、もう一人は手押し車を使います。
reader.archivedEnglish: One worker uses the shovel and another uses the wheelbarrow.
reader.reviewNote: Wheelbarrow must remain distinct from a generic handcart; inherits card 7.

reader.candidateJapanese: 古い釘を全て抜いてください。
reader.archivedJapanese: 古い釘を全て抜いてください。

reader.sourceSpanish: Después pasen el imán por el patio.
reader.sourceEnglish: Then run the magnet over the yard.
reader.candidateJapanese: それから庭の地面に磁石をかけます。
reader.archivedJapanese: それから庭の地面に磁石をかけます。
reader.archivedEnglish: Then run the magnet over the yard.

reader.sourceSpanish: Barran la cubierta antes de la sub-capa.
reader.sourceEnglish: Sweep the deck before the underlayment.
reader.archivedJapanese: ルーフィングを敷く前に屋根下地を掃いてください。
reader.archivedEnglish: Sweep the deck before the underlayment.
reader.reviewNote: Roof deck/underlayment terms and sequence inherit card 12; archived ルーフィング may narrow generic underlayment.

reader.sourceSpanish: Avísenme cuando terminen de recoger los clavos con el imán.
reader.sourceEnglish: Tell me when you finish picking up the nails with the magnet.
reader.archivedJapanese: 磁石で釘を拾い終えたら知らせてください。
reader.archivedEnglish: Tell me when you finish picking up the nails with the magnet.
reader.reviewNote: Finish picking up nails with a magnet does not establish verified zero nails or safety clearance; preserve the exact reporting instruction.
